materialization: No scorer starts until the recovered M0, observation, matched, shuffled-evidence, and resend model responses seal and all four wave-1 complete 104-row manifests verify. Passing canary responses occupy their ordinary complete-surface rows and are not repeated. The launcher writes exact manifest paths and per-job operations to a JSONL job file. Three unchanged official single-process scorers read the terminal recovered M0, matched, and shuffled manifests; one unchanged official single-process finalizer scores and settles resend. All four whole-manifest jobs run concurrently. Wave 2 starts only after the frozen cross-fitted policy has produced and verified its complete derivative manifest; the launcher omits a mode flag so evaluate_parallel.sh uses its supported default score operation.
aggregation_rule: Never split one dataset into scoring shards and never average shard-level metrics. Each worker invokes the unchanged official scorer on one complete 104-row manifest.
equivalence_rule: Every result must verify, bind the expected complete-manifest identity, and match the unchanged authoritative single-job result for the same manifest after excluding nonsemantic timing fields.
timing_receipt: Each batch-summary.json records outer wall time, sum of per-job elapsed times, effective speedup, worker count, per-job status, scorer identity, complete-manifest identities, and result hashes.
